title: Near and Far
author: Claude
blurb: Two short levels about near and far. A level can have two planes: a near scene with big, clear scenery and a far scene with the same kind of land drawn small, loading a paler palette. A trail is a link that takes Kit from one to the other. In the second level a cliff blocks the way near, and the far plane has no cliff. Signs say how. Play it, then open it in Game-Maker and change where a trail lands.

box.back: A small explorer in a teal beanie steps through a gap in a hedge into the distance, where everything is small and pale, and walks past a cliff that blocks the way near. Read the signs, then open the game in Game-Maker and move where a trail lands.
features: Signs in the levels explain each idea
A near scene and a far scene, drawn at two sizes
Made to be copied and taken apart
